finalMizo: Hei hi eng nge a awmzia?

english: How do you say this in Mizo?
aiMizo: Hei hi Mizo tawngin engtin nge an sawi?
finalMizo: Hei hi Mizo tawngin engtin nge an sawi?

aiMizo: Hei hi engtin nge an chhiar?
finalMizo: Hei hi engtin nge in lam?

aiMizo: Chu chu sawi nawn leh thei em?
finalMizo: I sawi nawn leh thei em?

aiMizo: Min zirtir avangin ka lawm e.
finalMizo: Min zirtir avangin ka lawm e.

english: I want to speak Mizo fluently.
aiMizo: Mizo tawngin ka thiam tak duh.
finalMizo: Mizo tawngin thiam takin ka tawng duh.

english: You are stronger than you think.
aiMizo: I in ngaih aia chak zawk i ni.
finalMizo: I rin aiin i chak a nia.

aiMizo: Kan theih ang ang kan ti ang.
finalMizo: Theihtawp i chhuah tlang ang u.

aiMizo: I mahni chauh i ni lo.

finalMizo: Engkim a tha leh vek mai ang.

aiMizo: Ni tha zawk a lo thleng dawn.
finalMizo: Ni tha zawk a lo thleng dawn.

english: I'm always here to help you.
aiMizo: I tanpui turin ka awm reng.
finalMizo: Tanpui tur che in ka awm reng.

english: You can talk to me anytime.
aiMizo: Engtik lai pawhin min biak thei.
finalMizo: Engtik lai pawhin min be thei.
I chungah ka lawm hle mai.

english: I was planning to go out today, but I decided to stay home because the weather looks like it might rain.
aiMizo: Vawiin chuan pawna kal ka tum a, mahse ruah sur tur anga a lan avangin inah awm zawk ka thlang ta.
finalMizo: Vawiin chuan pawna kal ka tum a, mahse ruah sur tur anga a lan avangin inah awm zawk ka thlang ta.

english: Even though I was very tired after work, I still decided to finish what I had started before going to sleep.
aiMizo: Hna ka thawh zawh chuan ka chau hle mahse, mu tur hmain ka tan tawh kha ka zawh hnu zawk ka tum ta.
finalMizo: Hna thawh zawhah chuan ka chau lutuk a mahse, mut hmain hna kha zawh law law ka duh.

english: I wanted to call you last night, but I thought you might already be asleep, so I decided not to disturb you.
aiMizo: Zan khan call ka tum che a, mahse i mu tawh ang tih ka ngaihtuah avangin, i buai lo turin ka call ta lo.
finalMizo: Nizanah khan call che ka tum a mahse, i mut tawh ka ring a, ka lo tibuai duh lo che a.

english: When I arrived at the bus stop, I realized that I had forgotten my wallet at home, so I had to go back and get it.
aiMizo: Bus stop ka thlen chuan, ka wallet inah ka theihnghilh tih ka hre chhuak a, chuvangin lak turin ka haw leh a ngai ta.
finalMizo: Bus stop ka thlen chuan, ka wallet inah ka theihnghilh tih ka hre chhuak a, chuvangin lak turin ka haw leh a ngai.

english: I was going to leave earlier, but I waited for my friend because we had planned to travel together.
aiMizo: Ka hma deuhin kal ka tum a, mahse rualin kal kan ruat tawh avangin ka friend ka nghak.
finalMizo: Hma takah chhuah ka tum a mahse, thiante nen a ruala kal kan tum sia, ka nghak.

english: If you finish your work early tomorrow, we can meet somewhere and have dinner together.
aiMizo: Naktukah i hna i zawh hma deuh thei chuan, khawi hmun emawah kan in hmu ang a, rualin zanriah kan ei ang.
finalMizo: Naktukah i hna i zawh hma deuh theih chuan, khawi hmunah emaw in hmu in dinner kan ei dun thei ang.

english: I have been waiting for you for a long time, so please let me know if you are going to be late.
aiMizo: Rei tak che ka nghak tawh a, chuvangin i tlai dawn chuan min hrilh lawk rawh.
finalMizo: Rei tak ka lo nghak tawh che a, chuvangin i tlai dawn chuan min hrilh lawk tawh rawh.

english: I don’t know whether I will have enough time to finish everything today, but I will do my best to complete it.
aiMizo: Vawiin hian engkim zawh tur hun ka nei tawk ang em ka hre lo, mahse ka theihtawp chhuah thlapin ka zawh ang.
finalMizo: Vawiin hian ka zo hman kher dawn em ka hre lo, mahse zo fel turin theihtawp ka chhuah ang e.

english: I was surprised when I heard the news because nobody had told me anything about it before.
aiMizo: Thuthar ka hriat chuan ka mak hle, a chhan chu tumah chuan a chungchang min hrilh lawk lo va.
finalMizo: Thuthar ka hriat khan mak ka ti lutuk a, a chhan chu tuman min lo la hrilh si lo a.

english: Although I was nervous at first, I became more confident after I understood what I was supposed to do.
aiMizo: A tirah chuan ka zam hle, mahse ka tih tur chu ka hrethiam hnu chuan ka huaisen zawk ta.
finalMizo: A tirah chuan ka zam hle, mahse ka tih tur chu ka hrethiam hnu chuan ka huaisen zawk ta.

english: I would like to visit that place someday because I have heard many people say that it is very beautiful and peaceful.
aiMizo: Ni khat chu hmun kha tlawh ka duh, mi tam takin a mawi tak leh nuam an tih ka lo hria a ni.
finalMizo: Engtikah emaw ka kal ve ka duh, a chhan chu mi ten a mawi in a zalen tiin an sawi a.

english: I wanted to help you yesterday, but I was busy at that time, so I couldn't come.
aiMizo: Nimin khan ka tanpui ka duh a, mahse chu hun lai chuan ka buai avangin ka lo kal thei lo.
finalMizo: Nimin khan puih che chu ka duh a, mahse ka buai ve lai tak a nia, ka lo kal theih loh phah.

english: Before you leave, please make sure that you have everything you need because you may not be able to come back later.
aiMizo: I chhuah hmain i mamawh zawng zawng i nei vek tih enfiah rawh, nakinah i lo kir leh thei lo mai thei.
finalMizo: I chhuah hmain i mamawh zawng zawng i nei vek tih enfiah rawh, nakinah i lo kir leh thei lo mai thei.

english: I didn’t expect the meeting to take so long, but we still had many important things to discuss before we could leave.
aiMizo: Meeting rei lutuk tur ka beisei lo, mahse kan chhuah hma chuan sawi tur thil pawimawh tam tak kan la nei.
finalMizo: Meeting rei lutuk tur ka beisei lo, mahse kan chhuah hma chuan sawi tur thil pawimawh tam tak kan la nei.

english: Whenever I have a difficult problem, I try to stay calm and think carefully before making a decision.
aiMizo: Buaina harsa ka nei apiangin, inthlahdah lo takin ka ngaihtuah fiah hmasa a, chumi hnuah chuan thutlukna ka siam.
finalMizo: Buaina harsa ka nei apiangin, inthlahdah lo takin ka ngaihtuah fiah hmasa a, chumi hnuah chuan thutlukna ka siam.

english: If the weather is good tomorrow, I plan to go out with my friends and spend the whole day enjoying ourselves.
aiMizo: Naktukah boruak a tha chuan, ka thiante nen pawna kalin ni pum pui nuam takin kan hmang turin ka ruat.
finalMizo: Naktukah khua a tha chuan, ka thiante nen chhuah a ni leng a in kawm hlim kan tum a ni.

english: Even if things do not go according to my plan, I will try to remain positive and find another way to solve the problem.
aiMizo: Ka ruat angin thil a kal lo pawhin, rilru tha nei reng tumin buaina sutkian nan kawng dang ka zawng ang.
finalMizo: Ka beisei loh dana thil a kal pawhin, rilru fim tak puin kawng dang zawn ka tum ang.

english: I am grateful for everything you have done for me, and I will always remember your kindness.
aiMizo: Ka tan i tihsak zawng zawng avangin ka lawm hle a, i thatna chu ka hre reng ang.
finalMizo: I thil min tih sak zawng zawng ah khan ka lawm tak zet, chuan i thatna chu ka hre reng ang.
